decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 4 - The premises shall only be used for retail purposes incidental to that of the Griffin Park Stadium.
Condition : 5 - Upon first occupation of the premises for retail purposes,  the existing club shop in Braemar Road shall cease, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted for retail purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 9:30am - 4:30pm Monday-Friday and 9am - 12pm Sat, on non match days. On match days it shall not be carried on outside 9am - 10pm (midweek) and 9am - 6pm (weekends).
description: Change of use from hall to shop use, including new front elevations to existing building.
